youtube.aciklama: In quiet breathing, inhalation takes about 40 percent of the breathing cycle. When speaking, we breathe in quickly and talk through a long exhalation; inhalation drops to about 10 percent of the cycle. The pressure below the vocal folds, called subglottal pressure, supplies the energy of the voice.
